title: The Sovereign's Key

sources.title: The Sovereign's Key
markers: {{story|The Sovereign's Key}} is a [[Miscellaneous#Story Items|Story Item]] which can be looted from [[Spaw|Sovereign Spaw's]] body. While in the inventory of an active party member, it temporarily neutralizes all [[mushroom]] and spore traps for the party in the [[Underdark]].

summary: Protects the party from myconid mushroom traps.

fields.Sovereign’s Protection: The party can pass affected mushroom traps such as Bibberbang safely. Does not work in camp or Grymforge.
fields.Acquisition: Carried by Sovereign Spaw and can be looted when knocked out.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
